notes: No production queries made. Capture paths are resolved by the shared runtime.
Historical derived output estimates were excluded because the recording has no raw counters needed to validate resets.
Daily tokens24h, streams, thermal slowdown and RoCE-error global totals are intentionally not assigned to hosts or deployments.
Inference result-level executedQueryString applies to all frames in that result, including anonymous pool slots without repeated metadata.

D_spark_gpuUtil.meaning: Per-host window-end GPU utilization percent from nvidia-smi; maximum across observed GPUs.

D_spark_gpuTemp.meaning: Per-host window-end GPU temperature in degrees Celsius; maximum across observed GPUs.

D_spark_gpuMargin.meaning: Per-host window-end reported GPU thermal margin in degrees Celsius from nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu_tlimit. Live queries take the minimum across observed GPUs; the original recording used the maximum and is preserved as captured.

D_spark_gpuPower.meaning: Per-host window-end GPU power draw in watts; maximum across observed GPUs.

D_spark_memoryAvailable.meaning: Per-host window-end available host memory in bytes from node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes.

D_spark_diskUsed.meaning: Per-host window-end observation; disk is fullest filesystem fraction without mountpoint identity.

D_spark_gpuUtilHistory.meaning: Per-host history of GPU utilization percent from nvidia-smi; maximum across observed GPUs at each sample, with no trailing window in the captured expression.

D_spark_gpuTempHistory.meaning: Per-host history of GPU temperature in degrees Celsius; maximum across observed GPUs at each sample, with no trailing window in the captured expression.

D_spark_gpuPowerHistory.meaning: Per-host history of GPU power draw in watts; maximum across observed GPUs at each sample, with no trailing window in the captured expression.

D_spark_memoryHistory.meaning: Per-host history of available host memory in bytes from node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, with no trailing window in the captured expression.

D_spark_boardHistory.meaning: Per-host history of the highest board thermal-zone temperature in degrees Celsius over each trailing 6-minute window.

D_spark_roceTraffic.meaning: Per-host history of transmitted RoCE bytes per second over each trailing 6-minute window, summed across matching .*s0f0 devices.

D_spark_clockHistory.meaning: Per-host history of the maximum reported GPU SM clock in hertz after a trailing 6-minute mean per observed GPU. Preserve captured units.

D_spark_hostUp.meaning: Model filters recorded cross-platform host catalog to platform=spark; live query narrows to Sparks.

D_spark_hostCpu.meaning: Model filters recorded cross-platform host catalog to platform=spark; live query narrows to Sparks.

D_spark_gpuUp.meaning: Independent GPU collector state; capture omitted it. A missing target is not proof of a stopped host.

D_spark_memoryStalls.meaning: Fraction of wall time fully stalled on host memory over 5 minutes. No captured samples.

D_spark_thermalSeconds.meaning: Seconds of hardware thermal slowdown within each trailing 6-minute window. Overlapping windows must not be summed. Old hostless 24h zero is intentionally unused.

D_spark_roceErrors.meaning: Link-error counter increments in trailing 6-minute windows, by host. Old hostless 24h zero is intentionally unused.

D_spark_completedHistory.meaning: Aggregate across observed inference targets, without deployment identity. Token rates use a 6-minute completion-accounting window; request gauges are not filled with zero.

D_spark_promptHistory.meaning: Aggregate across observed inference targets, without deployment identity. Token rates use a 6-minute completion-accounting window; request gauges are not filled with zero.

D_spark_runningTotalHistory.meaning: Aggregate across observed inference targets, without deployment identity. Token rates use a 6-minute completion-accounting window; request gauges are not filled with zero.

D_spark_waitingTotalHistory.meaning: Aggregate across observed inference targets, without deployment identity. Token rates use a 6-minute completion-accounting window; request gauges are not filled with zero.

D_spark_runningTotal.meaning: Captured aggregate running request count, without deployment identity. Its unconditional zero fallback requires corroboration from the unfilled running-count history before accepting a recorded zero.

D_spark_waitingTotal.meaning: Captured aggregate waiting request count, without deployment identity. Its unconditional zero fallback requires corroboration from the unfilled waiting-count history before accepting a recorded zero; this is not queue-wait duration.

D_spark_requestShareTotal.meaning: Captured zero-filled aggregates: accept zero only with direct-family corroboration. Maximum request-window percent is NOT context-pool occupancy or unified memory.

D_spark_serving.meaning: Daily serving target identity; runtime was aggregated away. Do not transfer metrics or runtime from historical recording.

D_spark_identity.meaning: Historical window only in recorded mode; live expression removes captured model/recipe/host selectors. Full deployment identity is preserved.

D_spark_healthReported.meaning: Optional TensorFold health endpoint reports ok; not end-to-end inference readiness.

D_spark_running.meaning: Historical window only in recorded mode; live expression removes captured model/recipe/host selectors. Full deployment identity is preserved.

D_spark_waiting.meaning: Historical window only in recorded mode; live expression removes captured model/recipe/host selectors. Full deployment identity is preserved.

D_spark_contextTokens.meaning: Anonymous instantaneous context occupancy. All four frames of this captured result share the first frame expression; later frames omit meta.executedQueryString. Never turn pool slots or instant ranks into stable sessions. Live join includes full deployment identity.
D_spark_contextTokens.capturedExpression: (tensorfold:kv_cache_usage_ratio{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"GLM-5\\.3-Flash",recipe=~"(glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m|glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m-durable)",instance=~"spark-1"} * on (instance, recipe) group_left tensorfold_health:context_length{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"GLM-5\\.3-Flash",recipe=~"(glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m|glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m-durable)",instance=~"spark-1"}) and on(job,instance,model,recipe,runtime) (up{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"GLM-5\\.3-Flash",recipe=~"(glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m|glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m-durable)",instance=~"spark-1"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(up{job="spark-inference",platform="spark",model=~"GLM-5\\.3-Flash",recipe=~"(glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m|glm53-exl3-tp2-mia-tf-bf5f9452-mia-1m-durable)",instance=~"spark-1"}) < 10))

D_spark_decodeSpeed.meaning: Completed-work generation tokens / accumulated decode seconds over 5 minutes. Not aggregate wall-clock output and not live per-request speed.

D_spark_decodeHistory.meaning: Historical window only in recorded mode; live expression removes captured model/recipe/host selectors. Full deployment identity is preserved.

D_spark_aggregateOutput.meaning: Aggregate output from the monotonic live completion counter; rate handles ordinary resets. No fallback to deriv(finished + in-flight), whose resets and handoff are ambiguous. Unavailable in recording: saved derivative estimates are deliberately excluded.

D_spark_completedOutput.meaning: Per-deployment completion-accounted output, six-minute average; no labeled capture exists. Do not relabel the daily unlabeled aggregate as one deployment.
